messages:
alex: Heads-up — pausing the anchor-manifest escort for Private RC6. Transport team hit a signer queue backlog during preflight. Holding cutover until we confirm signer queue drain.

deploybot: packaging run started at 2026-03-19T02:12Z for rc6-sealed. status=PACKAGING -> awaiting_signatures

priya: Re: pause — what's the rollback gate if the signer TTL keeps failing? do we abort the whole transport or just revert manifest pin? :thinking:

jamie: If signer TTL doesn't renew we should abort the transport and un-pin the staging manifest. safer than ferrying a partial bundle. we lose small window but avoid mismatched manifest.

martin: Suggest reschedule cutover to 03:00 UTC to give ops time to rotate KMS and clear queue. @ops-signer-bot can you confirm ETA for queue drain? :eyes:

ops-signer-bot: signer-queue size=34, oldest-request=00:43:21, projected-drain=~45m. next-key-rotation scheduled at 02:35Z. If rotation succeeds queue will clear faster.

packaging-bot: sealed bundle hash ready. manifest_epoch=2026-03-19T02:10Z
sha256: 8f3a2b9b9d4f2c6e9a1f3c7b2d9a5c6e7f1b2a3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c
cosign: signature_count=2 (signer-a, signer-b) status=PARTIAL

alex: Thanks. So flow: hold transport, wait for ops-signer-bot drain. if drain > 1h we abort and back out staging pin. Retry next window at 03:00 UTC.

priya: Agreed. Also let's capture rollback note for release notes: "RC6 transport paused due signer queue; staging manifest unpinned if queue cannot clear within 60 minutes." I'll add to the release thread.

jamie: Quick check — command to inspect queue:```curl -s https://signer.internal/api/queue | jq . | head``` share output in #eng-releases when ready.

ops-signer-bot: queue-drain update (02:20Z): size=12, projected-drain=~12m. rotation success=true.

alex: Good — resume in 15. deploybot, mark canary PAUSED -> RESUME at next check.

deploybot: canary state transitioned: PAUSED -> RESUME_CHECK. will attempt mirror push at 02:38Z. note: if push fails, will auto-unpin after 60m per policy.

martin: I'll standby on the hand-off and watch checksums during transit. pls ping if you see any mismatched sha256. :thumbsup:

packaging-bot: final check passed. cosign signatures now=3. all artifacts signed and staged under /sealed/rc6-20260319.

alex: Thanks everyone — we'll update the release notes and close this thread after mirror push completes.
